assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: wide landscape README hero, approximately 16:9.
Primary request: Create a refined, light-themed product marketing image for NeuraOS, a governed edge operating-system platform for robots and autonomous devices.
Scene: an elegant bright studio on a warm white background, with a cohesive arrangement of one compact generic edge computer, one warehouse AMR, one industrial robotic arm, one compact inspection drone, and a subtle marine inspection robot. Objects are realistic industrial design renderings, not toys, with correct proportions and physically plausible construction. No vendor logos.
Style: premium clean product photography combined with restrained 3D industrial visualization; soft daylight, ivory and pale grey surfaces, graphite hardware details, subtle teal connection lines. No dark futuristic backdrop.
Composition: wide, uncluttered, generous whitespace, clean visual hierarchy. A large central rectangular application display shows a simple white mission overview with a thin sidebar and five neatly arranged completed task nodes, framed as a design concept. Avoid dense tiny illegible text.
Text verbatim: large understated wordmark "NeuraOS"; a small discreet label "PRODUCT CONCEPT". On display only "Mission overview" and "SIMULATION". No extra slogans or claims.
Constraints: this is an AI-generated product concept, not a photo of deployed or shipping hardware. No customer logos, certifications, invented performance metrics, weapons, people, or watermarks. White and light colours must dominate. Polished enough for an enterprise customer-facing README.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity landscape application result-screen illustration for an enterprise README, wide 16:9.
Primary request: Design a polished light-mode NeuraOS mission result screen. Render the interface flat and front-on as a full software canvas, no device frame and no desk. Use white and warm off-white backgrounds, slate typography, soft grey hairline borders, restrained teal accents, clear cards and ample spacing. It must feel like a meticulous enterprise operational product.
Top bar exact text: "NeuraOS", "Mission results", a visible badge "SIMULATION", and "Illustrative interface".
Left sidebar exact labels: "Overview", "Missions", "Devices", "Network", "Evidence", "Profiles".
Main mission heading exact: "Inspection & maintenance".
Subheading exact: "Inspection to verified handoff".
A prominent completion card: "5 / 5 tasks", "Completed in the offline reference".
Three other summary cards exact text: "4 actors", "10 Node signatures", "112 SDK checks". Do not add any latency, energy, uptime, security certification or physical production metrics.
Central wide task timeline with exactly five completed stages in this order, precise labels: "Inspect", "Verify", "Transport", "Receive", "Closeout".
Below, a clean result table labelled "Evidence trail" with three readable rows: "Command approval — Verified", "Resource quorum — 3 of 4 voters", "Typed outcomes — 5 verified".
Right panel: "Run context", "Environment: Simulation", "Command authority: Approved", "Artifact integrity: Verified". A compact green check represents verification, not physical safety.
Footer precise label: "AI-generated UI concept · Offline example".
Constraints: clearly a product-design mockup, no claim of a currently implemented graphical dashboard or deployed customer system. All numerical labels are offline example counts, not performance measurements. No customer or vendor logos, no extra fictional metrics, no dark background, no visual clutter, no watermarks. Large legible text, correct wordmark spelling N-e-u-r-a-O-S.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: wide landscape light-mode customisation screen for the NeuraOS README, approximately 16:9.
Primary request: Create a polished, coherent enterprise configuration-screen design for NeuraOS. A flat front-facing software canvas with warm white background, slate typography, light grey borders, subtle teal highlights, compact technical labels and ample breathing room. No desktop or hardware photograph, no dark mode.
Top bar exact text: "NeuraOS", "Device profile", "Illustrative interface".
Sidebar exact text: "Overview", "Missions", "Devices", "Network", "Evidence", "Profiles"; highlight "Profiles".
Main heading exact text: "Configure your platform".
A clean selected profile card: "Custom ground robot", "Configuration draft".
Two-column form:
Left card title "Hardware & capabilities"; fields "Controller", value "Custom gateway"; "Compute", value "Board-specific profile"; "Capabilities", chips "Inspect", "Transport".
Right card title "Authority & connectivity"; fields "Command approval", value "Human approval required"; "Offline behaviour", value "Hold"; "Network policy", value "Authenticated links"; "Environment", value "Simulation".
A lower full-width card title "Mission and deployment options", with three orderly small option cards "Workflow", "Model selection", "Evidence retention". These are product customisation concepts, not proof all integrations are shipped.
Bottom buttons exact: "Save profile draft", "Review configuration".
Footer exact text: "AI-generated UI concept · Custom integration".
Constraints: all wording must be crisp and correctly spelled, especially NeuraOS. No enabled production switch, no deployment success badge, no certifications, no vendor endorsement, no fictional SLA or performance metric. Clear, appealing software design without excessive widgets. This is a design mockup for configurable integration, not a screenshot of implemented UI.
